description: This is a Java interface that extends JpaRepository to provide data access methods for the Matricula entity, including custom query methods for finding enrollments by course and user.

classes.name: MatriculaRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for managing Matricula entities with custom finder methods based on course and user.

methods.name: findAllByCurso
methods.description: Retrieves all Matricula entries associated with a specific course.

methods.name: findAllByUsuario
methods.description: Retrieves all Matricula entries associated with a specific user.

methods.name: findByCursoAndUsuario
methods.description: Finds a specific Matricula entry based on course and user combination.
